"Police never showed up, so I guess I don't have a claim."

We hear this a lot, and it's not true. You can still file.

Not sure if that's you? Give us a call.

How fault changes your recovery in Nevada, on a $100,000 award:

30% at fault, you get $70,000.
60% at fault, you get $0.

The line is 50%. You can recover if you're not more than 50% at fault (NRS 41.141).

5 Nevada injury rules worth keeping on your phone:

2 years to file an injury claim, 3 years for car damage only (NRS 11.190). Over 50% at fault means no recovery (NRS 41.141). No cap on pain and suffering in car crash cases. And if police didn't investigate, an SR-1 may be due to the DMV within 10 days (NRS 484E.070).
